scoring: Per-stage mean log-normalized program minus matched-expression control means (20 gene bins; up to 50 controls/bin; exclude all interpreted program genes from controls); control genes shared for raw-count scoring; scores standardized separately in each original library.
raw_sensitivity: Original integer counts normalized independently with original library totals; no rounding of corrected fractions.
duplicate_gene_symbols: Program scores select one feature per symbol, choosing highest pooled corrected-count abundance; support counts distinct symbols. All same-symbol features excluded in panel sensitivity; original counts remain unchanged.
gene_exclusion_sensitivity: Remove every interpreted program feature from the stage HVG embedding; repeat PCA/Harmony/graph/clustering. Not a proof of absent biology if neighborhoods change.
QC_score_sensitivity: Within-library-centered log raw UMIs, log raw detected genes, contamination, mitochondrial percentage, cycling-marker count and Xist/Y-marker expression; can remove biological state.
program_labeling: Prespecified source/marker conditions, >=.35 z effect, >.15 in both original libraries, raw effects positive, >=3 or panel-specific positive genes with corrected and raw positive contrasts in both libraries; HIF also requires non-glycolytic program.
state_support: n>=100, >=30 each library, largest fraction<=.9, >=3 both-library corrected/raw markers; mean seed Jaccard>=.65, min>=.5; QC and feature-exclusion Jaccard>=.5, uncorrected Jaccard>=.4. These are descriptive heuristics.
gradient_check: Score-neighbor Spearman on expression graph and after QC adjustment; 20 within-library shuffled reference distributions, not animal-level inference or spatial distance.
gate_correction: Earlier Etv1/Gja5-overlap label could exclude paper Slit2 trabecular CMs; retained as ambiguous reference, not assigned Purkinje identity.
limits: No measured wall position, tissue oxygen, force, metabolic flux, independent animal replication or causal environmental attribution. Author Table3 panels from same dataset are not independent validation.
core_gate_sensitivity: Reuse original 43,249-cell stage-specific core-only Harmony graphs; common program controls and core-library standardization; compare neighborhood coherence with expanded-gate results. Expanded-gate QC fit used for residual comparison.
primary_feature_clarification: Primary unsupervised HVGs can contain interpreted genes; programs are not used as a handpicked-only feature basis. Separate all-program-gene-excluded embedding tests dependence.
cycling_labels: Multi-gene cycling-enriched clusters explicitly labeled as control states, not microenvironment-induced types.
